item.name: Arcade Machine
item.requirement: Use the interaction prompt to play, or pick it up as a throwable
item.effect: Can be thrown for environmental damage or operated to play Unlicensed Catch Game and Unlicensed Flight Game.
item.baseDamage: 15 unblockable bullet-type damage while in motion
item.specialInteractions: Explodes into coins when it breaks. It can still be picked up while someone is playing it.
item.relatedMoves: Combat Instincts, Lurking Shadow, Boogie Woogie, and Severance Kick can interact with throwables. Arcade play connects to a daily quest and related emotes.
item.availability: Current source-backed throwable and arcade prompt

item.name: Piano
item.requirement: Use the interaction prompt to sit and play, or pick it up as a throwable
item.effect: Can be thrown for environmental damage or used as a playable piano with basic and more complicated notes.
item.baseDamage: 15 unblockable bullet-type damage while in motion
item.specialInteractions: Plays an unpleasant chord when it breaks. It can still be picked up while someone is playing it.
item.relatedMoves: Combat Instincts, Lurking Shadow, Boogie Woogie, and Severance Kick can interact with throwables. The normal play behavior overlaps the Piano emote controls.
item.availability: Current source-backed throwable and piano prompt
item.itemsPageOverlap: No current items-page row; overlaps emote behavior instead

item.name: Billboards
item.location: Two towers, with editing panels on the fourth floors
item.requirement: Kill requirement listed by the source
item.effect: Displays a custom image ID and the name of the last player who edited the billboard.
item.specialInteractions: The edit panel warns that inappropriate images can result in a ban.

item.name: Vending Machines
item.location: In or outside buildings and in Shinjuku Station
item.effect: Lets players buy Soda from the machine.
item.specialInteractions: Soda is the item created by the interaction. The vending-machine object itself is the interactable row.
item.relatedMoves: Soda overlaps the items page. No current source-backed character move interaction is listed for the vending-machine row.
item.itemsPageOverlap: Creates Soda, which is owned by the items page

item.name: Shinjuku Station Control Panel
item.requirement: Use one of the station control-panel buttons
item.effect: One button broadcasts to the subway station, and another calls a speeding train on the rails.
item.baseDamage: Train heavily damages players in its way; exact damage is not listed
item.specialInteractions: The train travels along the station rails after being called.

item.name: Unlicensed Rhythm Game
item.requirement: Interact with the karaoke machine and pick a song snippet
item.effect: Starts a Yakuza-style rhythm game and displays the player's score when it ends.
item.specialInteractions: The user gains full i-frames while performing.
